content: Oligo 0.0.0.0 Day (Aug 2024): public websites can dispatch requests to localhost services from the browser (0.0.0.0 bypass; ShadowRay RCE demo). Local services that skip CSRF/origin validation because they assume a private environment are exploitable; a single request can cause damage. Chrome PNA rollout and Safari block 0.0.0.0; Firefox lagged. Localhost binding alone is NOT origin protection: mutating endpoints must validate Host/Origin.
